title: Uniform boundary traction from a requested resultant force
summary: Converts an engineering total force into a uniform reference-boundary traction while preserving the requested MPI-global resultant.

science.statement: A known continuum-solid end force can be applied without a singular nodal load by distributing it over a named reference boundary.

equations.label: uniform reference traction
equations.description: The same constant traction is integrated over the selected reference edge or surface.

equations.label: resultant contract
equations.description: The boundary measure and verification integral are MPI-global.

inputs.name: resultant and boundary
inputs.unit_role: force and reference edge length/surface area
inputs.description: The vector dimension must match the mesh geometric dimension.

outputs.name: surface resultant load
outputs.description: The load retains requested resultant, measured reference size, and applied traction in its summary.

assumptions: The traction is uniform over the selected reference boundary.
In planar 2D the resultant is per unit out-of-plane thickness; in an axisymmetric Study, model.surface_force uses the complete revolved boundary area.
conventions: The force vector follows global coordinates.
Amplitude scaling acts on the complete distributed load.
The geometric measure is assembled unless an explicit positive reference_measure is supplied.
Direct loads.surface_force calls require study=study to select axisymmetric rather than planar measure semantics.
applicability: Continuum-solid end loads, verification beams, specimens, and distributing-load workflows.
limitations: surface_force is uniform; use distributing_coupling when a reference-point moment must also be transmitted.
The distributing load preserves resultants but does not yet create kinematic reference-point degrees of freedom or an MPC constraint.
Axisymmetric distributing_coupling and remote_force are rejected until ring/reference kinematics and moment semantics are implemented.

usage.minimal_example:
loaded = mesh.boundary(domain, right, name='loaded_end')
model.surface_force((0.0, -50000.0), on=loaded)

validation_rules: Reject non-finite or dimensionally incompatible resultants.
Reject an empty or non-positive reference boundary measure.
Integrate the generated traction and recover the requested vector.
Solve a clamped solid and verify global force balance.
